answer: Make one public randomness beacon pick each epoch's verifier lottery: only identities with recent verified work on their own terrace of the network can be drawn, and each drawn verifier must independently re-run a sampled piece of another agent's claimed work. Honest work rises like a lotus fed by clean water, but cloned identities share one origin and their samples collide — duplicated results expose the cluster and burn its bond. A sybil farmer pays the full cost of fresh verifiable work per clone, every epoch, while an honest agent simply does its job.
